items.title: Implement packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts with parallelism, manifest reading, and --tag/--select filters
items.context: Create packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts (TS source) + ensure its dist artifact builds. Behavior: scan `packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts` (or a manifest-configured list); spawn each smoke as `node packages/main/dist/tasks/<name>-smoke.js` in a worker pool (default size = os.cpus().length, overridable via --jobs N); per-smoke timeout from the manifest (default 60s); aggregate exit codes (fail if ANY smoke fails); print per-smoke `PASS`/`FAIL` lines + `<n>/<m> passed in <duration>s` summary; support `--tag <tag>` to run only smokes whose manifest entry contains <tag>; support `--select <substring>` to run only smokes whose name contains <substring>; do NOT touch any existing test:* script; do NOT modify any existing smoke file. Acceptance: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select run-all-smokes` runs only its own self-smoke; `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --tag fast` filters by tag. Build (tsc) passes.
items.userSees: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select <something>` prints PASS/FAIL per smoke + aggregate summary; running it without filters runs all 153 smokes in parallel and aggregates.

items.title: Create packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (initial manifest with default entries) and add `test:all` npm script at root
items.context: Create packages/main/smoke-manifest.json. Schema: a JSON object with a `smokes` array; each entry has `name` (file basename without -smoke.ts), optional `tags` (string array), optional `timeoutMs` (number), optional `skip` (boolean). For B1, populate it with a small initial set covering the runner's self-smoke and 2-3 well-known fast smokes (e.g. gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke, the lab description smoke); leave the rest discoverable by directory scan (default behavior when no manifest entry exists). Add to root package.json: `"test:all": "node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js"`. The 262 existing test:* entries stay untouched. Acceptance: `npm run test:all --select run-all-smokes-smoke` runs the new runner's self-smoke; `cat packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | python3 -m json.tool` parses; root package.json has the new entry.
items.userSees: `npm run test:all` runs every smoke + reports aggregate; existing `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` (etc.) still works byte-identical.

happy.desc: Validate manifest JSON parses: `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); if(!Array.isArray(m.smokes)) throw 1; console.log('VALID:'+m.smokes.length)"` -> prints VALID:N and exits 0; WHY: confirms manifest has correct top-level schema with smokes array

Verify test:all script in root package.json: `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.scripts['test:all']) throw 1; console.log(p.scripts['test:all'])"` -> prints runner invocation command; WHY: confirms npm script wiring to run-all-smokes.js
Run `npm run test:all -- --select run-all-smokes` -> exits 0, stdout contains PASS and summary; WHY: confirms npm script correctly forwards CLI args to runner

Each manifest entry has required name field: `node -e "require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json').smokes.forEach((s,i)=>{if(!s.name)throw new Error(i)}); console.log('ALL_NAMED')"` -> ALL_NAMED; WHY: validates per-entry schema

edge.desc: Manifest entry with skip:true is honored by runner: add temp entry {name:'skip-me',skip:true}, run runner -> skip-me does NOT appear in PASS/FAIL output; WHY: confirms skip flag prevents execution without error

Smoke not in manifest discovered by directory scan: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js --select actor-trust` -> exits 0 with PASS even though actor-trust-smoke is not listed in manifest; WHY: confirms fallback discovery for sparse manifest

Optional manifest fields validate: `node -e "require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json').smokes.filter(s=>s.tags).forEach(s=>{if(!Array.isArray(s.tags))throw 1}); console.log('SCHEMA_OK')"` -> SCHEMA_OK; WHY: optional tags/timeoutMs must match documented types

adversarial.desc: Existing test:* scripts in root package.json byte-identical to main: `git diff main -- package.json | grep -E '^[+-].*test:' | grep -v test:all | grep -v '^[+-]{3}' | wc -l` -> 0; WHY: story must not modify any existing test script in root

Existing test:* scripts in packages/main/package.json byte-identical to main: `git diff main -- packages/main/package.json | grep -E '^[+-].*test:' | grep -v test:run-all-smokes-smoke | grep -v '^[+-]{3}' | wc -l` -> 0; WHY: story must not modify any existing test script in sub-package

Strict JSON validation via python3: `python3 -m json.tool packages/main/smoke-manifest.json > /dev/null` -> exits 0; WHY: catches trailing commas and other lax-JSON that Node tolerates but spec forbids
Root package.json still valid after edit: `node -e "require('./package.json'); console.log('VALID')"` -> VALID; WHY: editing package.json can corrupt it with trailing commas or missing brackets

items.title: Add the runner's self-smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts
items.context: Create packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts that verifies the runner: (a) correctly detects a known-PASSING fixture smoke as PASS; (b) correctly detects a deliberate-FAIL fixture smoke as FAIL; (c) honors --tag filtering (running with --tag missing-tag returns 0 smokes); (d) honors --select filtering; (e) honors --jobs N parallelism (run with --jobs 1 vs --jobs 4, both pass). The fixtures can be inline JS strings the smoke writes to a tmpdir + invokes the runner with a config pointing at them. Standalone-runnable: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js`. Add `"test:run-all-smokes-smoke": "node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js"` to packages/main/package.json. Acceptance: the self-smoke exits 0 when the runner behaves correctly; if you deliberately break the runner (e.g. swallow a child's non-zero exit), the self-smoke fails with a clear pointer.
items.userSees: `npm run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` exits 0 on HEAD; injecting a runner bug makes it fail with a specific assertion message.

happy.desc: Run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js` -> exits 0; WHY: self-smoke passes when runner behaves correctly, confirming all 5 sub-checks (pass detection, fail detection, --tag filter, --select filter, --jobs parallelism)
Run `npm run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` -> exits 0; WHY: confirms the npm script in packages/main/package.json correctly invokes the self-smoke

Self-smoke with --jobs 1: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js` internally tests --jobs 1 vs --jobs 4 equivalence -> both sub-runs produce same exit code; WHY: parallelism edge case is part of the self-smoke contract per context item (e)

Self-smoke with --tag missing-tag-xyz sub-check: self-smoke internally invokes runner with nonexistent tag -> runner returns 0 smokes with exit 0; WHY: empty tag match is part of self-smoke contract per context item (c)

Self-smoke file is new, not a modification of an existing smoke: `git diff main --name-status -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts` -> shows A (added); WHY: must be a new file, not a renamed/modified existing smoke

Verify intent-coverage.ts still exists after CHK-003: `test -f packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts && echo EXISTS` -> EXISTS; WHY: always-on guard - self-smoke story must not delete cross-cutting infrastructure
